id_link_check.note: The other historical race IDs are outside this frozen 4,006-horse candidate cohort; the 611 supplemental profiles are a separate target group.

This one race-row name discrepancy remains unresolved; the row is non-finishing (ord 94, time 0).

sex_exception.interpretation: The official ID and name agree across all three records. API20 reports 암 22 days before the race and API42 reports 암 currently, while the single 2002 race row reports 수. This is an unresolved event-row sex inconsistency, not a same-ID join failure; it is distinct from 수-to-거 status changes.

historical_male_to_gelding_observations.interpretation: The sample shows a same-ID event-time transition from 수 to 거, followed by 거 records and current API42 status 거. The 6,634 rows across 493 IDs are temporal status differences and do not indicate horse-ID mismatches.
